transformations: Instance labels replaced consistently with neutral Unicode and multiword labels; escaped DNS fullnames and shell-friendly TXT display use matching substitutions.
Hostnames replaced consistently with endpoint-NN.local.; private IPv4 addresses replaced consistently with RFC 5737 documentation addresses.
Device identifiers, MAC-like values, pairing/public keys, group IDs and opaque TXT identifiers neutralized; TXT length octets and byte-count/hex display recomputed after substitutions.
Captured interface index, timestamps, flag bits, row order, table headings, ports and protocol/model/version fields retained.
limitations: Interactive user read-only DNS-SD capture; does not establish LaunchAgent Local Network consent or qualification.
Native registration, expiry/renewal, guest-to-LAN projection, shared Home Assistant discovery, packet return traffic and audible playback were not exercised.
Two selected endpoint resolves per type do not represent every instance in the separate bounded browse; capture is a point-in-time sample, not a complete inventory.
